summary: Keep position, velocity and acceleration consistent through ballistic flight.
objective: Launch a ball with editable initial velocity and compare its path with velocity and acceleration vectors until ground contact.
example_prompts: Launch a ball with editable initial velocity and compare its path with velocity and acceleration vectors until ground contact.

entities.name: Projectile
entities.guidance: Use a visible sphere with a matching contact radius; keep center trajectory distinct from lowest surface point.

entities.name: Ground
entities.guidance: Render a flat support plane with a metric grid and a clear impact marker.

entities.name: Vector overlay
entities.guidance: Use separate units/scales for displacement, velocity and acceleration; retain horizontal/vertical components.

state_contract.model: Uniform gravity a=(0,-g,0), finite initial position p0 and velocity v0 in SI units, g>0, sphere radius>0 and horizontal plane height h; analytic ballistic flight until first ground contact. Initial clearance c=p0.y-h-radius must be nonnegative.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Set launch state while paused; reject non-finite inputs, nonpositive gravity/radius and negative initial clearance.
Reset and compare two initial conditions.

invariants: During free flight only, p(t)=p0+v0*t+0.5*a*t*t and v(t)=v0+a*t.
At the apex vertical velocity is zero but acceleration is still downward.
Stop at first contact of sphere surface with ground; do not continue through the floor.
If initial clearance is zero and v0y<=0, contact is immediate at t=0. If touching with v0y>0, allow departure and stop at the later descending root; never choose the departure root as impact.
motion_guidance: Validate initial clearance before playback. For c=0 and v0y<=0 set contact at t=0; otherwise solve the later descending root of c+v0y*t-0.5*g*t^2=0. Evaluate analytic state only up to that contact time, avoiding frame-end penetration.
Declare stop-on-impact; a bounce needs a new restitution/contact model and post-impact state.
known_limits: No drag, spin, lift or terrain beyond the flat plane.
No bounce dynamics is claimed; a visible ball uses a contact radius but free flight treats mass as a point.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: Without air resistance, uniform gravity gives constant horizontal velocity and vertical position y=y0+v0y*t-0.5*g*t^2.
claims.scope: Flight before contact, upward-positive vertical axis.

physical_contract.scope: Analytic constant-acceleration ballistic model, terminated at first sphere-plane contact.
colliders: Sphere matching visible radius; static horizontal plane.
driving: Uniform gravity only; analytic state evaluation from immutable launch state.
contact: Reject initial clearance c=p0.y-h-radius<0; any tolerance-based snapping must be explicitly declared before contact classification.
For c=0 and v0y<=0, contact is immediate at t=0. For c=0 and v0y>0, select return time 2*v0y/g rather than the zero departure root.
For c>0, select the positive descending root; use a numerically stable quadratic evaluation for strongly downward initial velocity. Stop playback at contact; no restitution model.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate at simulation time; clip advancement to analytic impact time even across long render frames.
checks: At a free-flight apex vy=0 while ay=-g.
Touching launches with zero or downward vertical velocity stop at t=0; touching upward launch returns at 2*v0y/g.
An initially elevated downward launch hits at the positive descending root without frame-end penetration.
Reset restores p0,v0,time=0, discards previous contact history and reclassifies immediate contact from the launch state.
